description: This file defines the GatewayProcessManager class in Swift, which manages the lifecycle of a gateway process, including starting, stopping, monitoring, and reconnecting, along with handling environment status, logs, and external interactions.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A final singleton class that manages gateway process lifecycle and status updates.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets whether the gateway process should be active, managing start/stop logic.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and enables the launch agent for the gateway if needed.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the gateway process if conditions are met and it's not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process and cleans up related state.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the current environment status, optionally forcing the refresh.

methods.name: refreshLog
methods.description: Refreshes the log from the gateway log file.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to attach to an existing gateway process if available.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a description string for a gateway instance or health snapshot.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Generates a descriptive message for a failed attachment attempt.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if an error represents an authentication failure with the gateway.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Configures and starts the launchd gateway service.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a string to the internal in-memory log buffer.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel if needed, based on the current state.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the gateway is ready or timeout occurs.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the internal log buffer and deletes the log file.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path for commands.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the current project root path.

methods.name: readGatewayLog
methods.description: Reads and returns the tail of the gateway log file.
